Munich Re is one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance and insurance-related risk solutions. The group consists of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, as well as the capital investment company MEAG. We are globally active and operate in all lines of the insurance business.Since our founding in 1880, we've been known for our unrivaled risk-related expertise and sound financial position. We offer customers financial protection when faced with exceptional levels of damage - from the 1906 San Francisco earthquake to the 2017 Atlantic hurricane season. We possess outstanding innovative strength, which enables us to also provide coverage for extraordinary risks such as rocket launches, renewable energies, cyber attacks, or pandemics.We're also playing a key role in driving forward the digital transformation of the insurance industry, and in doing so have further expanded our ability to assess risks and the range of services that we offer. Our tailor-made solutions and close proximity to our customers make Munich Re one of the world's most sought-after risk partners for businesses, institutions, and private individuals.Our corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.This role will be part of the Re Insurance Life and Health Tower for Group Technology, responsible for driving project delivery, product management, and digital transformation across the RI Life and Health business units globally. The Tower ensures business needs are met while maintaining the stability, compliance, and security of applications, and supports data-driven, automation, and digital initiatives. By leveraging technologies like data analytics and AI, the Tower develops innovative solutions for both client-facing and internal operations across North and South America, Europe, and Asia.As a part of the Reinsurance Life and Health Tower you are responsible for RI Life and Health Solution Delivery. We drive the transformation of project delivery and product management for RI Life and Health business units across North and South America, Europe, and Asia.In the data and digital section, we are responsible for data-driven, automation, and digital initiatives in the Reinsurance Life and Health businesses. By leveraging innovative technologies such as data analytics and AI, we develop and support solutions for both client-facing and internal operations.As a Project Manager you will be responsible for the delivery of a diverse range of digital transformation projects in Life and Health. This position is a part of a cross-functional digital product team.Your Job- Driving the development of digital business opportunities and solutions together with the business stakeholders.- Creating, identifying and shaping complex business ideas across single projects and business domains where technology can provide a new, transformative approach to an existing business problem.- Setting up, planning and managing IT projects in cooperation with various other IT units  the clients and stakeholders, following the established MR standards.- Managing and being responsible for the implementation of requirements in an agile project setup.- Analysing and supporting the implementation of non-functional requirements like compliance, IT security, resilience and operations.- Overtaking responsibility for external providers in accordance with contractual agreements.- Handling and monitoring of project communication and stakeholder management.- Managing and being responsible for cost estimates and compliance gates.- Responsible for project budget and cost management.Your Profile- University degree, preferably in Mathematics or Information Technology, or an equivalent academic qualification.- Good knowledge of IT acquired in various positions (project management, requirements engineering, consulting, etc.) and therefore an in-depth knowledge of the processes in software development.- Several years of experience as a project manager in a multi-project environment.- Independent way of working, sense of responsibility, and interest in technology-related topics.- Highly developed analytical and conceptual skills allied to the ability to present complex situations in a clear and understandable way.- Several years of experience in the (re-)insurance industry including underwriting or claims systems.- Good knowledge of and experience with using AI technology in the SDLC and in project management.- Good knowledge of MR IT development standards and patterns.- Experience in leading a distributed team.- Distinct facilitation, negotiation and presentation skills.- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with all stakeholders, peers and team members.- Willingness to travel.- Fluent command of business English.Application InstructionsIn order to consider your application, we require your application to be submitted via our online applicant portal. In addition to uploading your CV, we recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position is of interest to you.About usAs the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.Unlock your potential- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.Rewards & Recognition- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. As part of our Munich-based Ultrasound Workspace engineering team, you will strengthen product security across the medical software lifecycle.Collaborating across functions, you will manage security risks, guide secure development, coordinate issues, and continuously improve security processes by evaluating and implementing state-of-the-art methods and ways of working, while maintaining audit-ready evidence aligned with Philips standards.You will plan and oversee product security assessments, including threat modeling, architecture and risk reviews, vulnerability assessments, and security verification.You will evaluate security risks and emerging threats, define proportionate mitigations, and ensure decisions and evidence remain documented and traceable.You will coordinate security issues and incidents and drive lifecycle improvements through secure development guidance, reviews, training, quality gates, and verification of outcomes.Working across product, engineering, quality, and security functions, you will actively evolve audit-ready processes and evidence, identify improvement opportunities, and introduce state-of-the-art methods and ways of working while strengthening application-security and medical-device cybersecurity expertise.The team’s working language is German and English. If you don't know German – a desire to learn is appreciated.Your role:- Plan and oversee product security assessments, including threat modeling, architecture and risk reviews, vulnerability assessments, and security verification.- Evaluate threats and vulnerabilities for product, patient-safety, privacy, operational, and regulatory impact, and ensure mitigations, decisions, and evidence are documented and traceable.- Monitor emerging threats, attack methods, technologies, third-party components, and security tools, and provide leadership with risk-based recommendations and improvement priorities.- Coordinate product security issues and incidents raised by internal or external stakeholders, from intake and investigation through communication, remediation, updates, and lessons learned.- Support and guide the engineering team on security topics, contributing hands-on to the implementation of security controls, fixes, and tooling where needed.- Drive lifecycle security improvements through corrective and preventive actions, secure coding guidance, design and code reviews, training, security tooling, quality gates, and verification of outcomes.- Own and continuously improve security processes, procedures, templates, work instructions, and audit-ready evidence in alignment with the quality management system. Evaluate and implement state-of-the-art methods, tools, and ways of working to keep them effective and current.- Collaborate across product, engineering, quality and maintain current application-security and medical-device cybersecurity expertise.- Success in this role means that product security is demonstrably embedded in the medical software lifecycle, security risks are addressed transparently and proportionately, and the organization remains prepared for audits, evolving threats, and post-market obligations.You're the right fit if:- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable discipline.- Hands-on software development and coding experience is expected, enabling you to review code and engage with engineering teams at a technical level.- Experience in product or application security for regulated or safety-critical software, covering secure architecture, risk and vulnerability management, testing, secure development practices and tooling, with the ability to provide actionable guidance to engineering teams.- Having worked in a regulated environmentExperience creating and improving controlled quality management system processes, procedures, and work instructions, and supporting internal and external audits or assessments by notified bodies, regulators, customers, or certification organizations.- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to support technical and non-technical stakeholders.- A structured, evidence-based, and pragmatic working style, with a proactive mindset, and the initiative to identify needs and to actively drive improvements forward.- Relevant security certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, CSSLP, or comparable credentials, are an advantage.Compensation & benefitsYou combine strong technical expertise with a proactive and structured working style. You are comfortable coordinating stakeholders from different disciplines, making sound engineering decisions, and driving change in a complex, quality-driven environment. Most importantly, you are motivated by contributing to products that help clinicians deliver better care and improve patient outcomes worldwide.Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is € 81,216.25 – €108,288.31.We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. How we work togetherWe believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
